_comment: Copy this file to portfolio.local.json and fill it in. That copy is gitignored;
this one is committed and must never contain real holdings.
It is the ONLY file in the repo that knows what you own. Everything else works
off ISINs it reads from the broker export, so the code is publishable and the
You do not have to write this by hand. Run the cockpit once with the file
missing and it will name every ISIN in your export that has no entry.

SE0000000000.name: A fund with no public feed

_schema.accounts: broker account number -> the short label you want to see on the page
_schema.equity_log_data_source: Notion DATA SOURCE id for the Equity Log (not the database id - they differ under API version 2025-09-03)
_schema.symbol: Yahoo Finance symbol, or null for 'no public feed; carry at the broker's own valuation'
_schema.bucket: free-text grouping for concentration reporting; anything unmapped reads as Unclassified
_schema.class: 'stock' -> judged by thesis: needs a target, a trigger and a written reason. 'fund' -> judged by allocation: needs a target weight and a drift band, not a thesis.
_schema.target_weight_pct: funds only. Intended share of the book, in percent. null means 'no policy set yet' - the cockpit reports that as an open gap rather than inventing a number for you.
